failing_checks.title: Per-action amount bound
failing_checks.reason: The only amount gate is the balance floor at StellarPaywall.tsx:153, which is a minimum-balance check and not a maximum. The 402-retry path signs whatever amount and asset the second server response declares, with no cap against the amount the user approved. The first-attempt path has no cap either,

failing_checks.title: Cumulative budget
failing_checks.reason: This is a per-call balance floor. No cumulative total, daily limit, rate limit or persisted spend record exists in the submitted files. Each Pay click, and each 402 retry, pays again with no running budget. The only other control is the human clicking Pay each time.

failing_checks.reason: The original payTo is fixed by the first 402, but the retry takes payTo, asset, network and amount from a second response served by the same counterparty. Nothing binds the destination to the requirement the user saw, so the recipient is set by server content.
